title: MCP registry search (Smithery Toolbox)
description: A registry-search MCP so the composer analyst can DISCOVER MCP servers by need — semantic search over the Smithery registry (7k+ servers) via the Smithery Toolbox meta-MCP — instead of hard-coding server names. Wired into the composer-authoring flow's install list (N200). Needs a free Smithery API key; the install writes a `${SMITHERY_API_KEY}` placeholder and the user fills it in `.insight-flow/secrets.local.json`. Trust note: this runs third-party code (`@smithery/cli`) via npx; the CLI version is pinned (not `@latest`) so an install is reproducible — bump it deliberately.
name: mcp-registry

inputs.name: SMITHERY_API_KEY
inputs.title: Smithery API key
inputs.description: Free key from https://smithery.ai — lets the composer search the MCP registry. Store it in .insight-flow/secrets.local.json (gitignored).
